summary: Parametric realization landed: the closed-enum ripple (Surface::SpineFrameSurface, Curve::SpineFrameCurve, both stored at Box<Curve>), the decorators (truck-geometry/decorators/spine_frame.rs: SpineFrameSurface + SpineFrameCurve over the landed recipe evaluators, full §8B.4 checklist, manual serde for the constructive laws so the closed enums compile), and the authored-topology sweep constructor (truck-modeling/src/spine_sweep.rs: one side face per profile edge, trajectory edges shared by identity, try_attach_plane caps, no sewing).

sections.1_enum_ripple: canonical.rs: Surface::SpineFrameSurface(SpineFrameSurface<Box<Curve>>), Curve::SpineFrameCurve(SpineFrameCurve<Box<Curve>>); derive_curve_method!/derive_curve_self_method!/derive_surface_method! extended; lift_up arm (ISC precedent); Surface::transformed arm (composes the stored matrix); Surface::include arm (delegates to the decorator); Surface::SearchNearestParameter<D2> arm; every inner curve match in Surface::include refuses a SpineFrameCurve query honestly; Plane::include routes SpineFrameCurve away from lift_up.
sections.2_decorators: SpineFrameSurface<S>/SpineFrameCurve<S> hold a SpineFrameRecipe<S, ProfileLaw, FrameLaw> + the window/point + a stored Matrix4 placement. Checklist: ParametricSurface, ParametricSurface3D, BoundedSurface, ParameterDivision2D, SearchParameter<D2>, SearchNearestParameter<D2>, Invertible, Transformed<Matrix4>, IncludeCurve (surface); ParametricCurve, BoundedCurve, ParameterDivision1D, Cut, Invertible, Transformed<Matrix4>, SearchParameter<D1>, SearchNearestParameter<D1>, IncludeCurve (curve). S_v analytic; S_s = spine derivative + frame evaluator; central differences only on the search path. include refuses trajectory containment typed (canonical Curve has no equality / a placed trajectory is unrepresentable) and compares ring Lines structurally. impl Spine for Curve and for Box<S>; From<LineSpine> for Curve, From<PolylineSpine> for Curve. Manual Serialize/Deserialize for ScalarLaw, Profile2D, ProfileLaw, FrameLaw, SpineFrameRecipe<S,P,F>, and both decorators (proxy derives keep the shape exact).
sections.3_constructor: spine_sweep<S: Spine + Into<Curve> + Clone>(recipe, stations) -> Outcome<Solid<Point3, Curve, Surface>>. Stations validated verbatim from the facet entry; V1 profile-law domain gates (through-zero scale, correspondence mismatch) refuse ConstructError::InvalidInput at the entry; the recipe is pre-validated over the stations (C1/FrameSingular gates fire on the ORIGINAL spine); the storage recipe converts the spine to Box<Curve>. k side faces on [s_first, s_last] x [v0_j, v1_j] with shared SpineFrameCurve trajectory edges (constructed once, cloned by identity, opposite orientations), straight ring Lines, start cap consumes the start ring as-is and the end cap consumes the reversed-and-inverted end ring; Solid::try_new is the sole assembly validator (debug_new banned).
sections.4_downstream: Arms only, as the compiler named them: canonical.rs (inner curve matches + entity matches), recognize.rs (Unrecognized), span.rs (no spans), truck-modeling cad.rs (NonCanonicalCarrier), truck-shapeops classify.rs (3 sites) and section.rs, truck-stepio out/geometry.rs (DisplayByStep refuses typed, StepLength totals), plus the canonical-internal matches. STEP-in needs no arm (STEP constructs canonical variants only, never these).
sections.tests: truck-geometry/tests/spine_frame_brep.rs (7 tests) and truck-modeling/tests/spine_sweep_conformance.rs (6 tests) written; truck-stepio step_out_refuses_spine_frame_variants_typed added to the out geometry test module. All 12 tests_required names exist verbatim and pass.
sections.deviations: 1) The packet's spine_sweep signature gains `+ Into<Curve> + Clone`: the closed enums store the decorators at `Box<Curve>`, so the storage spine conversion (S -> Curve -> Box<Curve>) needs `S: Into<Curve>`; Clone feeds the recipe clone. 2) recognize.rs/span.rs/cad.rs/out/geometry.rs receive arms beyond the write_allow census: the compiler proves them non-exhaustive after the canonical ripple and the done-when requires a green `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` (the same arms-only mechanism Section 4 describes for the downstream crates). 3) examples/step_face_timing.rs and tests/geometry_fingerprint.rs are pure `cargo fmt` reflows (3 and 7 lines) pulled in by the fmt gate; they were already non-clean at dispatch. 4) Nonplanar-cap test drives the cap attachment directly (a bent quad -> Error::WireNotInOnePlane): a valid sweep's station ring is always planar in its frame plane, so the refusal is the defensive typed boundary, not reachable from valid input.
